mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS category_id, c.name AS category_name, COALESCE(cb.amount, 0.00) AS budget_amount, COALESCE(bu.used_amount, 0.00) AS used_amount FROM categories c LEFT JOIN ( SELECT monthly_budget.user_id, category_budget.category_id, category_budget.amount FROM monthly_budgets monthly_budget INNER JOIN category_budgets category_budget ON category_budget.monthly_budget_id = monthly_budget.id WHERE monthly_budget.user_id = #{userId} AND monthly_budget.budget_month = #{budgetMonth} ) cb ON cb.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT bill.category_id, SUM(bill.amount) AS used_amount FROM bills bill WHERE bill.user_id = #{userId} AND bill.transaction_type = 'EXPENSE' AND bill.transaction_date >= #{startDate} AND bill.transaction_date < #{endDate} GROUP BY bill.category_id ) bu ON bu.category_id = c.id WHERE c.type = 'EXPENSE' AND c.active = TRUE ORDER BY c.sort_order ASC, c.id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO monthly_budgets ( user_id, budget_month, total_amount ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{budgetMonth}, 0.00 ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = id
